note: The sop window («Тактичний планшет»): an old tube monitor -- a thick rounded bezel, scanlines, an RGB mask, dark corners, a glare on the glass, a flicker and a rolling band -- showing a military HUD: the call sign of the branch and the pool as ammo gauges under a hazard stripe, the tree growing right in diamonds on an amber grid, and the target frame with the node's data. Root TreeWindow fills the screen; TreeStage is the mockup's 1600x900 stage, centred. Roles the menu fills are listed in source/ui/SKINS.md; numbers are the mockup's, measured in Chrome (build/ui/sop/reference.png).

panel.name: TreeOutside
panel.note: The dark around the tube on a screen wider than 16:9 (#stage's background).

panel.name: HudPlate
panel.note: The HUD plate (.hud): the call sign block (DevName over BranchName), the sub, and on the right the pool as ammo gauges. The skin puts BranchSub after the wider of the two call-sign lines and lines the pool rows up from the right edge (their widths are their texts').

image.name: HudStripe
image.note: The plate's border-image: the hazard stripe on top, its dashes along the 1-unit sides.

label.name: DevName
label.note: Capitals and letter spacing from the skin (OnShow).

icon.name: SopBranchMark
icon.note: Not in the mockup: with more than one branch, a mark after the call sign says it switches.

panel.name: PoolList
panel.note: The menu creates the pool rows (ozl_sop_pool_row) here; the skin places them right to left from this box's right edge, 18 apart.

raw.name: SopBranchNext
raw.note: Not in the mockup: the call sign cycles the branches when the faction has more than one (the skin's OnClick).

panel.name: TreeBox
panel.note: The tree (.tree, lcd): the scrolled content, the legend, the corner brackets above both.

raw.name: TreeScroll
raw.note: The tree: drag it, or the wheel. The menu sizes TreeContent. Its colour and style blank make the scrollbars the mockup's dark thumb (--cell-edge) instead of the engine's white bar, as the vanilla inventory scrollers do.

image.name: TreeGlow
image.note: The screen behind the tree (.tree lcd + .content .bg glow), opaque, stretched over the whole content as the CSS gradient is.

raw.name: TreeLines
raw.note: The 56-unit amber grid and every link, drawn by the menu.

image.name: SopFogStripes
image.note: The fog's 135-degree stripes, a pixel tile under TreeFogEdge: they show through the fade only, as in the mockup. The skin keeps it on TreeFogEdge's rectangle.

icon.name: TreeFogEdge
icon.note: The 80-unit fade at the start of the fog, clear on the left (the tree grows right).

label.name: TreeTipText
label.note: Wider than any tip on purpose: the menu sizes TreeTip from the text (GetTextSize) and TreeTip clips the rest.

frame.name: TreeLegend
frame.note: The legend under the tree (.legend): lcd, a 1-unit edge on top.

panel.name: LegendRow
panel.note: Lined up by the menu (FlowLater from the skin's OnShow) by the width of each item's TEXT plus 14: the English words are longer.

list.name: TreeTemplates
list.note: Holds no rows: it only declares the row files the menu creates outside the lists.

row.name: OZL_SopTierLabel
row.note: A tier label ('тир I'); the menu puts the row's corner on the label's centre (x along, 22 across).

row.name: OZL_SopOrLabel
row.note: АБО centred above the diamond of an any-of knot, its baseline 14 above the knot (the mockup's svg text). The SAME widgets as ozl_sop_price_chip: the engine handed this path the price chip's layout (stand 2026-10-31, on two fresh clients; a byte-identical copy under another name loaded right), so both files hold the same parts at the same size and the skin shows the right ones (LabelTick): whichever file the engine hands over, the row works.

row.name: OZL_SopPoolRow
row.note: One line of the pool in the HUD (.hud .prow): the name in capitals and the number under it, where the mockup's segment gauge began. No gauge: the owner dropped it (2026-10-31), it read as unrelated to the number. Created into PoolList; the skin places the rows.

row.name: OZL_SopPriceChip
row.note: A price chip of a node: the 7-unit square of the line (sitting on the baseline) and the amount; the skin centres the row under the node. Holds the hidden OrText of ozl_sop_or_label too (see there).

panel.name: TargetBox
panel.note: The target frame (.target): the card in 30 / 30 / 24 of padding, the corner brackets.

raw.name: CardScroll
raw.note: The target's data, top to bottom (.card, gap 14 between blocks, 8 inside one); a long one scrolls above the button. The stack is the mockup's 370 and the scrollbar takes the 10 beside it (the engine draws it over the content's right edge, which hid the last digits of a cost); colour and style blank give it the mockup's dark thumb, as on the tree.

panel.name: SopHeadRow
panel.note: «◇ ЦІЛЬ» (.c-head::before): the diamond is a sprite, Oswald has no ◇.

stack.name: CardName
stack.note: Word-wrapped by the menu into its lines (bitmap fonts: no MultilineTextWidget).

stack.name: CardMeta
stack.note: Word-wrapped by the menu into its lines (bitmap fonts: no MultilineTextWidget).

stack.name: CardDesc
stack.note: Word-wrapped by the menu into its lines (bitmap fonts: no MultilineTextWidget).

panel.name: SopTimeRow
panel.note: The time line: 'Тривалість: 1 хв 00 с' (CardTime), or while researching 'Лишилось' + the 7-segment clock + 'з 1 хв 00 с' (the skin shows those and grows the row to 47; the clock is 26 high, the words 18 px).

panel.name: CardTimer
panel.note: The big 7-segment clock (.tmr). The vanilla 7segment font has digits and no colon, so the skin writes the groups of OZL_Text.Clock into SopTimerG0..2 and puts the colon sprites between them; the menu only shows and hides this container.

frame.name: CardSegs
frame.note: The 16-high segmented bar of a running project (.pbar): 20 segments, 3 apart; 8 above it.

frame.name: CardOpensList
frame.note: The skin lines the 'opens' chips up here (ozl_sop_opens_chip) and sets the height to what they take.

frame.name: CardFoot
frame.note: The button (.go, 70 high, a 4-unit frame) and the reason under it.

raw.name: BtnResearch
raw.note: style Empty: a style-less button paints a light box under the mouse.

panel.name: BtnResearchHover
panel.note: Under the mouse while enabled (.go:hover): amber with the word in the screen's colour.

list.name: CardTemplates
list.note: Holds no rows: it only declares the card's row files (built 370 wide, the stack's width).

row.name: OZL_SopCostRow
row.note: A cost line (.crow): the 14-unit chip of the line, the name, 'have / need' on the right and under them the dashed bar -- a solid track and fill with the comb of 2-unit gaps (8 on, 2 off) painted over both in the plate's colour. The 8 before the line is the gap between lines.

row.name: OZL_SopOpensChip
row.note: A node this one opens (.opens a): the name in a 2-unit frame, 12 in from it. The skin lines the chips up (gap 6, wrapping) and sizes the frame to the text; ChipHit is the click.

raw.name: ChipHit
raw.note: style Empty: a style-less button paints a light box under the mouse.

label.name: ChipText
label.note: Wider than any name: the skin measures the text (GetTextSize) and clips nothing.

icon.name: CrtRoll
icon.note: The roll bar (.roll): a soft 160-high band, moved from -160 to 900 every 7 s by the skin's OnUpdate.

image.name: CrtGlow
image.note: The glass (#stage::after): the glare and the dark corners. Its alpha flickers like crt-flicker (OnUpdate).

image.name: CrtLines
image.note: Scanlines 2 of 4: a 16-pixel tile repeated at one texel per screen pixel. Flickers with CrtGlow.

image.name: Bezel
image.note: The tube's bezel (#stage::before): the 26-unit casing rounded 54, its ring and the dark band, above everything.

raw.name: BtnClose
raw.note: Not in the mockup: the window has no close control (Esc closes it), so a word on the casing's bottom rim does.
